issue.title: A MEET close carries its later meetings to the end of the ledger
issue.description: When closing a MEET Pomodoro creates a new MEET placeholder for meetings that have not happened yet, that placeholder becomes the last future Pomodoro, in both capture `x` and Obsidian Ctrl+Enter, so other planned work comes first.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/meet_continuation_goes_last.md requests this work
